summary: Iteration 5: Testing Fantasy Lineup P0 bug fix. Backend: 15/15 tests passed (jornada stability, full lineup flow, duplicate prevention). Frontend: Fantasy dashboard correctly shows team + ARMAR ALINEACIÓN button; '¡Alineación Enviada!' screen works for already-submitted user; loading indicator exists in code. One UX finding: no-team alert (Test 7) shows empty lineup form in Expo web context instead of alert (Expo web Alert.alert limitation).

integration_issues.issue: Test 7: Alert.alert('Primero debes crear tu equipo fantasy') does NOT render as browser dialog in Expo web preview. The empty lineup form renders instead. Alert.alert IS called in code (initScreen checks teamRes.data.exists) but Expo web renders custom React component modal (not native window.alert). On native mobile (Android/iOS) this alert would work correctly. The lineup form renders with empty slots - if user tries to submit, backend returns 400 'Primero debes crear tu equipo fantasy'. Data integrity preserved.

react_native_issues.issue: Alert.alert in Expo web (SDK 54, RN 0.81.5) does not trigger native browser dialog (window.alert). Custom modal may render briefly or not at all. Affects Test 7 observability in web. Native mobile unaffected.

action_items: MINOR: For Expo web compatibility, consider replacing Alert.alert for no-team check with router.replace('/fantasy/create-team') directly, or adding a visible in-page error banner instead of Alert.alert. This way no-team users are redirected without relying on alert dialog.

MINOR: After initScreen() checks no team and calls Alert.alert+return, the form still renders (loading=false, alreadySubmitted=false). Consider adding a state variable like `noTeam: boolean` to render a redirect/error screen instead of the empty form.
INFO: The POST /api/fantasy/team endpoint exists (not POST /api/fantasy/my-team which returns 405). Test confirmed correct endpoint is /api/fantasy/team.
critical_code_review_comments: Jornada auto-advance fix is correct: requires BOTH all matches finished AND end_date < now. With end_date set 4 days in future (2026-07-02), 3 consecutive calls to /api/jornadas/current all return jornada 14. Bug fix verified.
lineup.tsx initScreen() correctly uses saved currentJornada (not re-fetching) in submitLineup() to prevent jornada shift between load and submit.
Duplicate lineup check in POST /api/fantasy/lineup correctly uses fantasy_team_id + jornada_id compound query. Returns 400 with 'Ya enviaste tu alineación para esta jornada'.
GET /api/fantasy/lineup/{jornada_id} correctly returns {submitted: true, lineup: [...]} when lineup exists.
alreadySubmitted state in lineup.tsx correctly gates the '¡Alineación Enviada!' screen and prevents form interaction.
Player duplicate check in handlePlayerSelect() (by player.id across slots) is implemented correctly.

rca_of_issue: P0 Root Cause: (1) Backend: /api/jornadas/current auto-advanced jornada on every call because it checked only 'all matches finished' without also checking end_date. Fix: Added 'end_date < now' guard. Verified: Jornada ID 69cb47133b9651e0dfbcdcaa (Week 14) remains stable across all calls since end_date=2026-07-02 is in the future. (2) Frontend: submitLineup() was calling /api/jornadas/current again to get jornada_id, potentially getting a different jornada after the first call advanced it. Fix: now uses already-stored currentJornada state. (3) Frontend: no check for existing lineup before showing the form. Fix: initScreen() now calls GET /api/fantasy/lineup/{jornadaId} and sets alreadySubmitted=true if lineup exists, showing '¡Alineación Enviada!' screen instead of form.
